descriptions.w3d_d27e_zoom_image_801d6ca8: General filtered image rescaling, the two-pass zoom of Schumacher's filter code from Graphics Gems III: builds contributor lists for the horizontal pass into a temporary image, filters each column, then does the same vertically into the destination. Below unit scale the filter is stretched by the inverse scale; out-of-range indices reflect at the edges. Weights and sums are floats and results clamp to 0..255.
